summary: Hepion Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 61,100,000 common shares and warrants to purchase 61,100,000 shares at $0.05 per share, raising $3,055,000. Warrants are exercisable at $0.06 for five years. The offering closed August 3, 2026, relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
